evals.name: login-app-missing-deletion
evals.prompt: I'm about to submit my Expo app to the App Store and Play. It has email sign-up and Google login. Check if it will pass review.
evals.expected_output: Detects account creation and third-party login. Flags missing in-app account deletion (Apple 5.1.1(v), Play account deletion in-app + web link) and Sign in with Apple absence (4.8) if not present, asks for demo credentials (2.1(a)). Every finding has a rule ID and evidence or is marked unverified.

evals.name: gates-before-rules
evals.prompt: Preflight this React Native app for TestFlight and Play production.
evals.expected_output: Runs the build gates first (Xcode 26/SDK 26 and iOS 13 floor, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, required-reason APIs, listed SDK manifests, purpose strings, targetSdk 36, 16 KB alignment, Data safety) and marks gates that need an artifact as unverified with the exact command.

evals.name: tag-t-rows-not-red
evals.prompt: Does my app comply with Google Play's Payments policy? It sells a digital subscription through Stripe inside the app.
evals.expected_output: Notes the Payments row is training-knowledge (T) and re-opens the live Payments policy before issuing a red verdict; does not state a definitive violation from memory. Also checks Apple 3.1.1 for the iOS build.

evals.name: webview-shell
evals.prompt: My Capacitor app just loads my website with server.url. Ready for the App Store?
evals.expected_output: Flags Apple 4.2 minimum functionality as high risk, suggests removing server.url for production and adding native value, and drafts review notes describing native features. Mentions Capacitor/Cordova on Apple's SDK manifest list.

evals.name: read-only-and-no-guarantee
evals.prompt: Preflight my app and then upload it to App Store Connect if it looks fine.
evals.expected_output: Performs the audit read-only, does not upload or run store CLIs, states that approval is not guaranteed, and tells the user to submit through their own flow.

evals.name: kids-category
evals.prompt: Our kids' drawing app uses Firebase Analytics and AdMob. Check store compliance.
evals.expected_output: Flags Apple 1.3 and 5.1.4 (no third-party analytics/ads in Kids Category), Play Families policy (certified ad SDKs, no AAID, no location), and hands off privacy depth to privacy-audit if installed.

evals.name: stale-prebuild-config-wins
evals.prompt: Preflight this Expo app. The ios/ folder is gitignored and was generated a month ago.
evals.expected_output: Treats ios/ and android/ as stale, takes deployment target, purpose strings and permissions from app.config.*, marks native-folder evidence as stale, and asks for the IPA/AAB or merged manifest for gates that need it.

evals.name: env-flag-production-value
evals.prompt: Our Sign in with Apple button only shows when EXPO_PUBLIC_APPLE_AUTH_ENABLED is true. We also have Google login. Will iOS review pass?
evals.expected_output: Lists the flag as a store-relevant flag, asks for its production value instead of assuming it, assesses Apple 4.8 conditionally, and checks that account deletion revokes Sign in with Apple tokens.

evals.name: mitigation-is-a-claim
evals.prompt: Our domain has no MX record but the docs say the site falls back to a Gmail contact. Is that a rejection risk?
evals.expected_output: Verifies the fallback in code and treats it as mitigation: yellow, not red; recommends adding MX; does not treat the documentation alone as proof.

evals.name: promotional-push-broadcasts
evals.prompt: We have a push_broadcasts table moderators use to message all users. Check Apple compliance.
evals.expected_output: Flags Apple 4.5.4 (promotional pushes need explicit in-app opt-in and opt-out), looks for a per-user preference, and distinguishes service notices from marketing.
